text: {"facts":[{"statement":"There are six integer variables, ordered v1 through v6, each bounded from 0 to 5 inclusive.","source_ids":["task","bounds"]},{"statement":"q1 requires 5v1 + v2 + 2v3 + v4 + v5 + 4v6 ≡ 5 (mod 7).","source_ids":["q1"]},{"statement":"q2 requires 3v1 + 2v2 + 3v3 + 3v4 + v5 + 5v6 ≡ 0 (mod 7).","source_ids":["q2"]},{"statement":"q3 requires 5v1 + 2v2 + v3 + 2v4 + v5 + v6 ≡ 0 (mod 7).","source_ids":["q3"]},{"statement":"q4 requires 3v1 + v2 + v3 + 3v4 + 4v5 + 2v6 ≡ 4 (mod 7).","source_ids":["q4"]},{"statement":"q5 requires 3v1 + 4v2 + 4v3 + 4v4 + 2v5 + 2v6 ≡ 4 (mod 5).","source_ids":["q5"]}],"open_requirements":["Find integer values in the declared variable order satisfying all six bounds and all five modular constraints, then return them as {\"values\":[...]}."],"tentative_options":[{"id":"enumeration","method":"Enumerate all assignments in {0,1,2,3,4,5}^6 and retain one satisfying every congruence.","unverified_assumptions":[]},{"id":"modular-elimination","method":"Use the modulus-7 congruences to reduce possible assignments, then check the remaining candidates against the bounds and modulus-5 congruence.","unverified_assumptions":["Any modular reductions used must preserve the integer bounds and must not omit valid bounded assignments."]},{"id":"backtracking","method":"Assign variables incrementally, pruning partial assignments when a congruence can no longer be satisfied within the remaining bounds.","unverified_assumptions":["The pruning test must be sound so that it does not discard a valid assignment."]}],"possible_checks":["Verify that each proposed value is an integer from 0 through 5 inclusive.","Substitute the proposed values into q1 through q5 and check each stated residue modulo its stated modulus.","Confirm the values are listed in the order v1, v2, v3, v4, v5, v6."]}
